baseline.focusVisible: Global focus-visible treatment remains defined for links, buttons, inputs, selects, textareas and summaries.
baseline.touchTarget: Interactive controls use a 44px baseline through global form/button classes or explicit min-h-11 sizing.
baseline.responsiveContainers: Wave 5 pages use responsive grids/flex layouts and intentional horizontal scrolling for dense chip/tab controls instead of fixed desktop-width content containers.

fixes: History period filters and source disclosures now preserve 44px touch targets.
Heritage map filters now preserve 44px touch targets.
Makati Calendar geography chips and filter controls now preserve 44px touch targets.
Makati in the News now exposes aria-busy for refresh state, role=alert for feed failure, and larger related/source/summary targets.
Mobility route-filter Clear and expandable detail summaries now preserve 44px touch targets.
Explore Makati expandable resource disclosure now preserves a 44px touch target.
Global Search category chips now preserve 44px touch targets.

responsivePatterns.pattern: Period chips scroll horizontally on narrow screens; filter form moves to two columns only from sm.
Map controls wrap and the text/map split is deferred to xl.
Dense section chips use overflow-x-auto on narrow screens and wrap at sm.
Discovery chips use overflow-x-auto on narrow screens and wrap at sm.
Views are single-column until md; filter controls expand progressively to md/xl.
Headline cards remain single-column until lg; metadata uses flex-wrap.
Result tabs intentionally scroll horizontally while results remain fluid-width.

search: Search input remains a combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls and active-descendant state.
Search results remain role=listbox with role=option rows.
No-result external handoffs and missing-result action preserve 44px targets.
async: News fetch failure is announced as an alert.
filters: History and Calendar filters retain visible labels.

principles: Wave 5 surfaces use shared Section, Heading, brand buttons/chips and responsive card patterns where appropriate.
No page was forced into a single template when its content model needs a different information hierarchy.
Dense metadata wraps rather than forcing horizontal page overflow.

bounded.reason: Repository/source QA cannot prove actual rendering at production viewport sizes.
Existing brand tokens and accessibility guardrails are preserved; a browser-based contrast pass belongs with live visual QA.
Static source checks verify responsive intent, not every browser/device rendering outcome.
